name: rlarch
description: Four skills for working in large codebases. dotnet-reflect — inspect any NuGet package or assembly's API surface straight from the DLL on disk: exact signatures merged with XML docs, decompiled method bodies, reverse find-usages read from IL, and version diffs. dotnet-source — ReSharper-style navigation of the .NET solution you're editing, read from .cs with Roslyn, so it sees private members and still works on code that doesn't compile. ts-source — the same shape for the TypeScript/JavaScript project you're editing, read with the TypeScript compiler API: search, outline, JSX-aware find-usages, the module import graph, and dead-code detection that separates what you can delete from what is merely over-exported. orchestrate — execute a plan too large for one context window by delegating every task to subagents, verifying each result against the goal, and re-planning when reality diverges.
